question: What effect does abstaining from food by day have on age and death?
premises: This practice affects the condition of aging and death.
The result is described as going beyond age-related death.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death due to age.
uncertainties: the exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is contextually interpreted as overcoming or passing beyond
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death due to age.
